generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
No Interest will be paid for EMD (Bid Security)

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Work Completion or Execution Period 11 Months
All other terms and Conditions are as per tender documents

Super Grade Electrical Contractors License issued by the Government of Karnataka for electrical work and class-I Civil Contractor registered in KPWD shall be uploaded for civil works along with other bidding documents failing which the offer will be rejected.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

The Tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year(both days inclusive)
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason
The Corporation is not responsible for any delay in accessing kppp portal
Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible will only be considered for evaluation

The items quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials and other taxes as per the rates prevailing Govt Orders at the time of execution and including all the cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all lead and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipments, etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work
Department or Corporation will not supply any materials
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable

The contractors are instructed to submit only relevant information with records as required and specified in qualification criteria. Any junk, superfluous and unnecessary documents if uploaded will treated as misleading and such tenders are liable to be rejected
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

Bidder should have experience- Executed in the 66-110kv Infrastructure work or above class substation &amp Transmission Line in New Industrial layout. The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division Equivalent officer and countersigned by the Superintending Engineer of the concerned Circle / next higher officer. Necessary documentary evidence and end user certificates for the same should be uploaded along with the bid. Failing reserves the right to reject any or all the Bids without assigning any reasons thereof.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed &amp commissioned as prime contractor, one similar work on Total Turnkey Basis such as Establishing of 2X20 MVA, 66-11kv class or above category Sub-Station of value not less than Rs.6500.00 Lakhs each similar work during last 5 years reckoned back from 2025-2026. Necessary documentary evidence and end user certificates for the same should be uploaded along with the bid. Otherwise reserves the right to reject any or all the Bids without assigning any reasons thereof.

The intending bidder should have Completed &amp Commissioned as prime contractor, one similar work such as Construction of Single Circuit 66kv 1x 630 Sq.mm Copper UG Cable or above voltage class. which shall be satisfactorily completed the laying of cable and commissioned successfully works of value not less than Rs.3030.00 Lakhs. The Bidder must have executed such works during the last five years, i.e reckoned back from 2025-26. Necessary documentary evidence and end user certificates for the same should be uploaded along with the bid. Failing to submit reserves the right to reject any or all the Bids without assigning any reasons thereof.

The Bidder shall have demonstrable experience in the execution of projects related to Transmission Line Towers involving special design. The scope of such experience must include preparation of structural and shop drawings, fabrication of prototype towers, inspection, and type testing of prototype towers for 66 kV or above class Double Circuit (D-C) special narrow based monopole towers, in accordance with applicable technical specifications. The Bidder must have executed such works during the last five years, i.e., from FY 2021-22 onwards. Necessary documentary evidence and end user certificates for the same should be uploaded 10 Section IFB along with the bid. Failing reserves the right to reject any or all the Bids without assigning any reasons thereof.

Bidder should have experience/ Executed at least two similar work on Total Turnkey Basis for the Civil works related to Substation, value not less than Rs.2000.00 Lakhs The Bidder must have executed such works during the last five (5) years, i.e., from FY 2021-22 onwards. Necessary documentary evidence and end user certificates for the same should be uploaded along with the bid. Failing reserves the right to reject any or all the Bids without assigning any reasons thereof.

Bidder should have experience/ Executed in the 66/110kv Infrastructure work or above class substation &amp Transmission Line in New Industrial layout. The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division / Equivalent officer and countersigned by the Superintending Engineer of the concerned Circle / next higher officer. Necessary documentary evidence and end user certificates for the same should be uploaded along with the bid. Failing reserves the right to reject any or all the Bids without assigning any reasons thereof.

The intending bidder should have Supply/Executed a minimum quantities of following critical items of work before submission of bid in any one year during last 5 years reckoned back from 2025-2026. Certificate should be obtained from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division and countersigned by the Superintending Engineer of the concerned Circle.1. 66kv SF6 Breakers or higher voltage 1 Nos. 2. 66kV UG Cable 630Sqmm or higher Cable along with suitable joint kits 29 Kms. 3. 66kV Current Transformer or higher voltage 3 No 4 Site levelling, cutting and filling 39450 Cum

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability by owning or brought on hire /lease basis the following key and critical equipment for this work 1) Hydraulic Crane 2) Three Sheave Arial Rollers 3) Hydraulic Compressor Jointing Machine 4) Drum lifting Jacks 5) Come along clamps 6) JCB 7) Road Roller &amp Grades 8) Rolling Compactors 9) Excavators &amp Dozers

technicalCriterionList.description: Qualifying requirements for UG Cable manufacturers a) Shall be an ISO 9001 / ISO 9002 (or higher) approved Cable manufacturer in India and should have minimum of 05 (five) years of experience as on the date of opening of techno commercial bid in the design, manufacturing, testing, supply of 66 KV, 1x630 Sq.mm, or higher size and voltage class, XLPE insulated, Copper conductor, Lead sheathed, Compact Circular Segmental Milliken type EHV underground cables.
